text: complete two-paragraph text; neither paragraph states fixed notice, source-disclosure, marking, same-license, installation-information, or other compliance duties, because any such duties arise only from the unspecified OSI-approved license chosen under paragraph 1; obligations are therefore represented by unknown

text: complete two-paragraph text; the choice instruction does not identify which acts activate conditions, and distribution, modification, combination, linking, network-use, or patent-claim triggers can be determined only after an OSI-approved license is selected, so triggers are represented by unknown

text: complete two-paragraph text; it contains no fixed warranty, liability, trademark, patent-claim, or additional-terms clause, while the presence and form of such restrictions depend on the unspecified selected OSI-approved license, so restrictions are represented by unknown

text: complete two-paragraph text; no patent grant or patent-termination rule is stated, and the selected OSI-approved license may have a materially different patent position, so the dynamic choice cannot be classified as express-grant, none-stated, or either termination category and remains unknown
